interview:
I won! 🎉

Here's what happened: After entering the name "Chonk" and starting the game, the cat began in the bottom-left corner, the fish was in the top-right corner, and the guard dog started near the center of the 7×7 board with several obstacle squares scattered around.

My strategy was to take the long way around the dog: I moved the cat right along the clear bottom row (4 moves) to the bottom-right corner, then straight up the rightmost column (6 moves) to reach the fish. The dog chased me the whole time but always stayed a few squares behind, since it could only move one square per turn and the obstacles plus my path kept it at a distance.

On the final move, the cat reached the fish square, and the game displayed **"Le Chonk got the fish! 🐟"** with a "Play again" button — a win in 12 moves.
